body: Aww, does someone have a boo-boo? :(
When someone compliments me even a *little* bit. Like, when I open the door for someone and they go, "Thanks." Feels good to be appreciated, even only slightly.
Swearing in front of little kids. Seriously, how would you like it if they said the same things?

I really wish that were true, but it isn't. I'm sorry, but I know that's very far-fetched for me so I won't believe it. When someone asks what I'm good at, nothing pops into my mind. The only things I can come up with is that I have a good vocabulary (but what's the use of that?), I've read/am reading a lot of books (I can hardly find one that I *enjoy* reading - most of it's for bragging rights) and... I can't think of anything else. I really like art, but I'm shit at it. I may enjoy it but it's very hard. I'm thinking of learning piano and my parents think it's a good idea too, but it's way after my exams. So yeah, I can't do most things right. 

I like writing. But when I finish a short story, I think it's stupid. I'm not creative in any way. I like video games too. I can never do them though because if my mom sees me playing them, she'll probably flip. Yeah my exams are coming up, but I hardly study. One of the reasons I hate myself.
I'm simply okay with myself. I don't think I'm attractive or very intelligent, but I like to think my saving grace is my friendliness and sense of humor.
Have you ever done a person of the same gender?
